prompt: A Kwi (Kwi), a Star Wars canon creature. The Kwi were large, bipedal saurians native to the planet Dathomir. They were herbivorous and yet remarkably sociable and intelligent. They were believed to be the degenerated descendants of the saurian 'Kwa' race. How they arrived on the various worlds they populated is unknown; perhaps they are the long descendants of the pan-galactic 'Kwa' or maybe they are just escaped circus specimens. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
style_notes: RimWorld creature sprite, Star Wars desert bestiary, our own art (not the donor mod's).
